thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty P1 fired — HTTP 502 rate spike in prod-usw2 (route: /v1/infer, 5m avg error rate 18%). Alert: https://pd.example/INCIDENT-12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Pager INC-12345 created, urgency: high, triggered by policy: inference-gateway-5xx-spike

maya: acked and taking it. oncall here, maya (US shift).

sanjay: seeing 502s coming from auth-proxy upstream -> tls renegotiate errors and short-lived connections. traces: https://trace.example/trace/0x9abc

lena: runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/edge-502 -> first step reduce edge route weight to fallback pool.

marc: running scale up on gateway in usw2 now: \n```\nkubectl scale deployment inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=12\n```\n\nmarc: gateway pods show high restart count on auth-sidecar, increasing replicas to absorb.

sanjay: tail of auth-proxy logs: \n```\n[2026-03-17T02:10:12Z] WARN connection: TLS renegotiate failed: short read\n[2026-03-17T02:10:19Z] ERROR kvcache: eviction spike, memory backpressure\n```\n\nmaya: temporary mitigation applied: reduced route weight for prod-usw2 -> fallback-usw2 (30% traffic) and enabled circuit-breaker for auth-proxy.

lena: command to change weight (internal router): \n```\nPOST https://router.internal/api/v1/adjust-weight\n{\"service\":\"inference-edge-usw2\",\"weight\":0.3}\n```\n\nerin: pinged CS & trust teams: \"We're investigating 5xx spike in US-West, routing partially shifted, customers with high QPS may see degraded latency\"\n
incidentbot: Escalation timer paused (ack by maya). No auto-escalation while oncall acknowledged.

sanjay: initial hypothesis: auth-proxy keepalive bug + kv-cache thrash under burst. I pushed a temp fix to drop keepalive reuse for auth sidecar in usw2 (will be reverted after postmortem).

marc: after weight change + scale, 5m error rate dropped to 3% and request latency normalized. metrics: https://metrics.example/dashboard/abc (error_rate graph)

maya: confirming customers: top 5 tenants saw increased 502s for ~12 minutes, CS notified, CSEs standing by.

erin: sent short status to #customers-notify: \"Resolved: routing fallback + scale reduced errors; follow-up email pending\" :white_check_mark:

lena: next actions: 1) postmortem, 2) add auth-proxy keepalive threshold to runbook, 3) adjust autoscale triggers to react faster to eviction signals.

maya: handing off to daytime SRE for deep dive — @sanjay will lead postmortem. I’m off in 15m, leaving notes in the incident doc.

incidentbot: Pager INC-12345 annotated: acknowledged by maya, mitigated, status: monitoring.

marc: one-line mitigation summary for postmortem: \"Reduced route weight to fallback pool + scaled inference-gateway; temporary auth-sidecar keepalive disable; error rate returned to baseline.\"\n
maya: closing handoff. will check back in tomorrow for RCA draft. thanks all :thumbsup:
